articles.summary: Today, I am thrilled to announce Letter AI has raised $10.6M in Series A funding, led by Mark Roberge (founding CRO at Hubspot) at Stage 2 Capital with participation from Lightbank, Y Combinator, Formus, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Mangusta, and others.
articles.title: The Next Chapter: Letter AI Raises Series A Funding to Help Revenue Teams Thrive
